entries.title: Forgive Me Father
entries.definitive_edition: Forgive Me Father on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the native PC build; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: The Windows PC version is the best archive route because it is the original full-release platform with PC capture/settings flexibility, while the PS4, Xbox One, and Switch ports do not have platform-exclusive campaign content over PC.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Forgive Me Father on Steam, GOG, or another PC storefront and play the current Windows PC build.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster or expansion edition is documented.

entries.title: Forgive Me Father 2
entries.definitive_edition: Forgive Me Father 2 on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the native PC build; no emulation is needed.

primary.version: Current PC release / Deluxe Edition extras as desired
primary.why: The Windows PC version is the best archive route because the full 1.0 release launched on PC storefronts first, PC has the highest capture/settings flexibility, and the later PS5, Xbox Series X/S, and Switch versions do not have platform-exclusive campaign content over PC.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Forgive Me Father 2 on Steam, GOG, or Epic Games Store for Windows PC and play the current 1.0+ build; choose the Deluxe Edition only if you want the artbook/soundtrack extras.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster is documented; Deluxe Edition extras are artbook/soundtrack-style extras rather than exclusive gameplay.
